name: Bakunyuu Saimin Nurse ~Yakan Shift Haramase Choukyou~
original_name: 爆乳催眠ナース ～夜姦シフト孕ませ調教～
source:
The main character, Yuki Tsuzuki, is hospitalized at a certain clinic due to a severe cold. He is recuperating surrounded by beautiful busty nurses. Perhaps due to the medication, his memory becomes vague, and he spends his days suffering from strong drowsiness day and night.

Every night, he begins to dream of a man who uses erotic techniques and engages in perverted play with a nurse. (Maybe he's just feeling frustrated...?) It worries him.

Although he feels uncomfortable with the dreams, he gradually becomes absorbed in it.

One day, one of the nurses, Kaena Kumada, told him that his dreams were a reality. He learns that the man in his dream is himself. At night, he can't stop the urge to attack the nurses and Yuki's behavior escalates further.

Eventually, he discovered the ero room in the basement of this clinic, He will learn his true purpose for coming here.
translation:
主人公津津木优纪因重感冒住进某诊所，周围都是美丽丰满的护士。也许是药物影响，他的记忆变得模糊，日夜都饱受强烈困倦折磨。

每天晚上，他都会梦见一个男人用色情技巧与护士进行变态游戏。这让他感到不安，或许只是欲望得不到满足？

虽然他对这些梦感到不适，却逐渐沉迷其中。

某天，护士熊田香苗告诉他，梦境其实是真实发生的。他得知梦里的男人就是自己。夜里，他无法停止袭击护士的冲动，行为也变得越来越失控。

最终，他发现了诊所地下室的色情房间，并将在那里得知自己来到这里的真正目的。
